objects.name: Analytic 1654
objects.description: For iOS, detect Compromise Hardware Supply Chain by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Correlation window between enrollment/inventory concern and suspicious network activity.
Most strong posture and inventory analytics require supervised iOS devices.
Apple, MDM, update, enterprise, and managed SaaS destinations vary by organization.
Expected background network behavior varies by managed app set and policy.
Benign activation, restore, and setup traffic can be noisy immediately after provisioning.
Defines how recently the user must have interacted for activity to be considered expected.
Tuning for acceptable changes in inventory/configuration during upgrades or replacements.
